'''October 2001 Fort Collins tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ft. Collins, Colorado on 20 October 2001. It is known from Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3074">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-24-ft-collins-co-10-20-01-ojat-jizzd3074/ ft-collins-co-10-20-01-ojat-jizz], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 24 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-24-ft-collins-co-10-20-01-ojat-jizzd3074/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Ft. Collins, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
